name: Frutiger Aero
tagline: Sky-and-grass optimism — translucent glass with a hard specular band, bubbles and water droplets
source: original — the 2004–2013 consumer-tech register (sky above, grass below, gloss over both), built with generic optics only; no Microsoft trade dress, and the display face is a Frutiger-adjacent free humanist sans because the real Frutiger is a commercial Linotype licence
use_when: consumer software, device and OS-adjacent marketing, playful dashboards and onboarding, media and lifestyle products — anything that should feel bright, glossy and friendly rather than severe
